text: Fenwick Thatros

Lord Varimathras has just sent me a missive about a threat to the Forsaken that must be immediately removed. His name is Fenwick Thatros, one whom Lord Varimathras believes is a leader of the undead that have taken root in Silverpine Forest.

Your name came to mind immediately, <name>. I have faith enough in your abilities that you will carry out this mission flawlessly.

The latest reports from the Deathstalkers in Silverpine indicate that Thatros can be found near the decrepit dock on Lordamere.
Kill Fenwick Thatros and bring his head back to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter of the Undercity.
I have placed the utmost faith in you to perform this service for Lord Varimathras.

You've done well, <name>. It occurs to me that you have performed many services for the Deathstalkers, proving your worth, and that perhaps it is time that we furthered your training in the shadow arts.
Tools of the Trade

The wizards of the Kirin Tor at Ambermill have stored away important documents pertaining to the current state of Dalaran. This we know from the admissions of one of our prisoners. Lord Varimathras has placed the duty of recovering them in the hands of the Deathstalkers.

This task falls to you, <name>. You will need some equipment, however, and the knowledge of lockpicking. Speak with Estelle Gendry, our outfitter, and ask her for a set of tools before you set out.
Find the Dalaran Status Report and return it to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter of the Undercity.
Have you located the documents, <name>?

Very good, <name>! You have learned the fine art of lockpicking well, and faster than I could have possibly expected.

I see that I was right to place my trust in you. Believe me, boy, I foresee that you will go far in this line of work.
The Apple Falls

They say I'm 'lovestruck,' whatever that means.

Sure, I spend my every waking moment thinking about Syurna. Sure, my home is full of paintings and drawings of Syurna. Sure, I often go days without eating, sleeping, or drinking, while I lament about the love we could have had. Is that so wrong?

Now she won't see me! ME! I've tried sending her messages but she won't even talk to another person unless they are a rogue.

Could you deliver this flower to her? Don't forget to tell her it's from Jannok.
Take Jannok's Rose to Syurna in Darnassus.
Oh, isn't this wonderful. You've brought flowers for your own funeral.

Had I saved every flower that dolt, Jannok, had sent me, I would have had the means to open a shop. Regardless, it seems as if Jannok's latest courier may prove to be useful.

Interested in some work, <class>?
Destiny Calls

We believe there is one being that may be able to help us understand what is happening to the forests of Teldrassil. Unfortunately, getting the creature to cooperate has proven disastrous.

He hides on a branch at the outskirts of the Oracle Glade. All who have so far approached the satyr, whether through force or diplomacy, have met with doom. Perhaps stealth is the answer, <name>.

Find what Sethir the Ancient carries in his packs and report back to me.
Find Sethir the Ancient and bring back any clues that you may discover to Syurna.
Have you anything to report from Sethir the Ancient, <name>?

This is grim news, <name>. It would seem that the sickness which has gripped the forests and rivers of Darkshore has begun to taint our home.

You have served us well, but there is nothing more you can do here. Take this blade as a reward for your service to Teldrassil.
Erion Shadewhisper
Do not worry, <name>, I am not sending you to see Syurna. Erion requires your presence at the Cenarion Enclave. Make haste!
Contact Erion Shadewhisper in Darnassus.
It is time to branch out, <race> - the world awaits.
Erion's Behest

Word of your deeds has spread far and wide, <name>. So far, in fact, that Stormwind Intelligence has asked for you by name.

The journey is taxing and not without peril, but an opportunity to train under SI:7 should not be taken lightly.

A new world awaits you, <name>. Make your way to Old Town in Stormwind and speak with Renzik "The Shiv" at SI:7 headquarters.
Travel to Stormwind City and seek council with Renzik "The Shiv."
You have answered SI:7's calling, <name> and journeyed from distant shores to join our ranks, however, there is much for you to learn.
Redridge Rendezvous

Sending you out in the field now would be suicide. Renzik doesn't need another dead rogue on his hands. Don't fret, though, <name> - Renzik is going to get you up to speed.

Make your way to the Redridge Mountains and speak with an associate of SI:7 named Lucius. You will find him hanging around the docks of Lakeshire with the other shady good-for-nothings.
Venture forth to Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains and speak with Lucius.
Ah, so your fingers are a little fat, eh? Don't worry, <name>, I've turned more useless thieves than you into accomplished rogues.
Alther's Mill
